title: Two-term dg kernels and bounded profiles of universal localisations
description:
Every proper dg algebra over a field with cohomology in degrees −1 and 0 is realised as the dg endomorphism algebra of a perfect kernel generator for a stably flat universal localisation of finite-dimensional algebras at one map. The target is projective on both sides, and the marked kernel embedding is standard t-exact with full finite-dimensional profile. Conversely, a standard t-exact marked realisation of a connective dg algebra by an ordinary homological ring epimorphism forces a two-term projective generator. The paper also studies the bounded profiles of these embeddings and asks whether a higher multiplication can change the profile poset at fixed graded cohomology.

The accompanying research notes (November 2026) answer that question, classify the full profile poset of a six-dimensional example, and extend the classification to an infinite family of dg algebras whose Koszul duals have a regular normal element. The deposit contains the paper, its LaTeX source and computational supplement, and the notes with their verification scripts.
